subject: RFP: On-Prem / VPC Technical Evidence for Zenith Capital
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@zenithcapital.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.t@zenithcapital.com>, procurement@zenithcapital.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP — additional on‑prem / VPC evidence needed

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the performance figures. Our security and infrastructure teams are working through the RFP and have a few follow-ups specific to on‑prem/VPC deployments before we move to legal/procurement: 

1) Network topology and firewall rules required for a private control plane (we prefer a flow that avoids any inbound holes).
2) Process and controls for air‑gapped imports (how customers install model artifacts offline).
3) Evidence of recent compliance scans and a SOC 2 snapshot.
4) HSM/KMS integration details and supported providers.

Can you send technical artifacts and the answers below as an attachment or a secure link? We need to present these to the infrastructure review on Friday — appreciate anything you can turn around quickly.

Regards,
Marco Ruiz
Senior Security Engineer
Zenith Capital

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@zenithcapital.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.t@zenithcapital.com>, procurement@zenithcapital.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP — additional on‑prem / VPC evidence needed

Marco —

Thanks for the clear list. I'm attaching a short packet and linking a Drive folder with more detail (link below). Quick summary up front: 

- Private control plane: by default Redwood Private deploys a customer‑managed control plane inside your VPC. No public inbound ports are required; control plane egress uses TLS to our optional proxy endpoint if you choose hosted telemetry, otherwise all telemetry can be routed to your internal collectors.
- Air‑gap model import: we provide a signed artifact bundle that can be transferred via removable media. The import tool runs in an isolated admin VM and validates signatures against customer‑supplied CA or Redwood root cert.
- KMS/HSM: we support AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, and common HSM vendors (Thales, Vault HSM integrations). Keys can be customer‑managed; Redwood only stores key references.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 snapshot attached; we also included a penetration scan summary (redacted) and a checklist for air‑gap readiness.

Attachments: redwood_onprem_network_design.pdf, SOC2-snapshot-2026Q2.pdf, evidence_airgap_checklist.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-redwood-zenith-evidence

If you want, Marissa can run a short technical call to walk through the network diagram and firewall rules in detail.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@zenithcapital.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.t@zenithcapital.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP — additional on‑prem / VPC evidence needed

Hi Marco / team —

Following up with the technical specifics you asked for. I'm pasting the short, actionable items here so your infra reviewers can copy/paste: 

Network & Firewall (minimum):
- Outbound TLS (443) from control plane admin hosts to configured telemetry endpoint (optional).
- Internal service ports (within private subnets): 7000 (runtime RPC), 7001 (KV cache sync), 9443 (internal admin UI, optional).
- SSH access to admin nodes is disabled by default; bootstrap uses ephemeral console only. If you require jump hosts, we recommend a bastion in a management subnet with strict security group rules and MFA.

Air‑gapped model import (summary):
1) Admin exports signed bundle from Redwood build service (or Redwood provides pre‑signed model bundles for supported models).
2) Customer imports via the import-cli from an isolated admin workstation; the CLI verifies PKI signatures and checksum.
3) The import process writes to an encrypted model store behind the customer KMS/HSM.
4) Optional: offline attestation report generated and stored in your internal artifact repository.

KMS/HSM notes:
- Key wrapping supported with AES‑GCM (local key material never leaves HSM).
- We support bringing your own HSM (BYOHSM) or integrating with cloud KMS via private endpoints.

I've included a small runbook and network diagram in the attachments. Happy to do a 30‑minute walkthrough with your infra team. What timezone works for you?

Thanks,
Marissa
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@zenithcapital.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP — additional on‑prem / VPC evidence needed

Marco —

Couple of security points from my side (I'm the Head of Security Ops):

1) Vulnerability & patching cadence: Redwood provides weekly runtime patches and monthly security bulletins. For private/on‑prem customers we automate patch distribution through an out‑of‑band artifact repo; you control the rollout window. We also provide a signed delta update so you can verify authenticity offline.

2) Logging & audit: Admin actions and token issuance are logged to a local audit store with tamper‑evidence (hash chaining) and can optionally forward to your SIEM over TLS. Retention settings are configurable per deployment.

3) Pen testing & reporting: I've attached a redacted executive summary of our recent pentest and the SOC 2 snapshot included in Priyom's email. For RFP purposes we're happy to sign an NDA and provide a fuller report to your security team.

4) Air‑gap attestation: our air‑gap import tool produces an artifact manifest and an import verification log. The manifest is signed and includes the exact runtime/image digests we install. If you need reproducible builds inside your environment, we can provide the build recipe under a separate MSA.

Attachments I added: airgap_import_runbook.zip (contains import CLI steps, signature verification example, and offline revocation guidance).

If Zenith wants a short attestation letter covering these items, we can prepare one. Priyom / Vivek — please coordinate; Hannah I'll need the attestation template you used for the Kepler bank deal.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Ops
Redwood Inference
